global_organization_chain: Summary: two numberless blocks, then one block per task, memorandum unnamed (p1).
Introduction: the same two blocks trimmed, a six-bullet work plan, one framework figure (p3).
Assumptions: eight bullets, five with the forcing reason indented beneath (p4).
Notation: one sentence pointing at the table, rare symbols defined at first use (p4).
Preprocessing: two purposes, one fill rule, every corrected value printed (p5).
Analysis: the series is a time series, so a time-series model (p6).
Prediction: LSTM introduced by the failure it fixes, three gates, one-at-a-time tuning (pp6-9).
Strategy: a naive all-in rule rejected, then the general program, then six behaviors on one template (pp9-15).
Result: a dated initial triple, two figures, one result sentence (p16).
Proof: ten metrics, four rival strategies each declared as such, one chosen comparison (pp17-20).
Sensitivity: one factor at a time, behavior counted before profit, difference then similarity (pp21-23).
Memorandum: four-line header, three imperatives, a scope concession (p24).
Strengths and weaknesses: one strength and one weakness per model (p25).

skeleton_review.two_numbering_systems: Section numbers and task numbers diverge. Section 4 is task 1, section 7 is task 4. Only the contents page prints both.
skeleton_review.template_reuse: The six trading behaviors share three sentences and change only the sign pattern. The two sensitivity sweeps share both bullet shapes and change only the because-clause.
skeleton_review.claim_strength_drops: The summary says the best strategy. The work plan says good enough. The result section says more than 13 times where the summary said exceeds 13 times.
skeleton_review.bold_budget: Bold marks the method at first mention, one dollar figure, and the conclusion sentence. It is not used for every number, and the memorandum drops it.
skeleton_review.where_the_paper_argues_with_itself: Figure 7's log axis hides the gap Table 4 reports. Figure 8's histograms do not support the normality the Sharpe ratio needs. The caption of Figure 5 promises dates the figure lacks.
skeleton_review.reusable_spine: desire, client, task blocks, verb-list plan, assumptions with indented reasons, model introduced by the failure it fixes, cases on one template, metrics, rivals declared as rivals, one-factor sensitivity, letter with a concession, one weakness per model
skeleton_review.not_reusable: The capital after a comma, the missing task number, the backwards range v-iv, and the three-decimal cell among four-decimal cells are this team's habits, not a pattern.

model_retention.equation_free_boundary: Both retained models carry equations; none were invented to fill a gap.

fact_notation_claim_warnings.precise_source_claim: The predictions are proven good by comparing the predicted curve and the real curve.
fact_notation_claim_warnings.warning: Figure 4 shows the two curves nearly overlapping and shows nothing else: no baseline forecast, no error bar, no holdout split. Overlap can support shape agreement. It cannot support the word proven. The skill must not use a curve overlay as a proof of forecast quality.

fact_notation_claim_warnings.precise_source_claim: The figure compares the five strategies fairly.
fact_notation_claim_warnings.warning: Figure 7 plots log of value. Table 4 puts the ideal strategy's annualized return at 1406.66 percent and ours at 266.36 percent, and the log axis compresses that gap so the two curves finish close. The caption never says the axis is logarithmic. The skill may use a log axis for series with very different ranges. It must say so in the caption and must not read closeness on a log axis as closeness in level.

fact_notation_claim_warnings.precise_source_claim: The Sharpe ratio is valid because the yield rates are normally distributed.
fact_notation_claim_warnings.warning: Figure 8 draws a normal curve over five histograms. Four of them are spikes at zero and only bitcoin spreads out. The sentence under the figure says all five follow a normal distribution. The skill must not cite a normality figure that contradicts four of its own panels.

fact_notation_claim_warnings.precise_source_claim: When the gold commission increases, the net profit remains the same and the win rate shows an upward trend.
fact_notation_claim_warnings.warning: Table 6 prints profits 10874.24, 14325.13, 13069.35, 14587.49, 10865.78. The largest is at 3 percent, not at the lowest commission, and the endpoints differ by 8.46. The win rate dips at 3 percent. The skill may summarize a noisy column. It must not say remains the same of a column that moves by thousands.

fact_notation_claim_warnings.precise_source_claim: When the bitcoin commission increases, the win rate shows a decreasing trend.
fact_notation_claim_warnings.warning: Table 8 prints win rates 0.4583, 0.381, 0.2745, 0.2954, 0.303. The series falls for three steps and rises for two. The skill must describe the turn, not only the first half.

fact_notation_claim_warnings.precise_source_claim: The memorandum recommends trusting the prediction because it is accurate, and states an annualized return of 266.36 percent, about 13 times.
fact_notation_claim_warnings.warning: The body proves the forecast only by the curve overlay warned above, so the word accurate in the letter has no stated test behind it. The summary says the profit exceeds 13 times, the result section says more than 13 times, and the letter says about 13 times, while 14325.13 divided by 1000 is 14.3. The skill may restate a result more loosely for a non-specialist reader. It must not let the looser sentence say a different number, and it must not carry a proof word the body never earned.
